Given no data, we should respond that insufficient information. But the required format expects SMILES. Could we output empty? Probably not.

Thus we should indicate we cannot determine. But maybe we should request mass spec etc. However we have no sample; the tools operate on "sample at hand". The environment likely has a sample with unknown data. We could call mass_spectrometry_spectra to get data, then deduce. That would be expensive but allowed. We need to justify resource use.
